auth.description: Server getUser validates the session for an explicit authenticated or canary presentation rollout. This grants no backend or admin access. Founder-only opt-in review retains confirmed identity, owner role and AAL2.

tenant.description: Approved research results are saved through existing private StorageService and returned only after issued actor context, owner-scoped confirmation, consumed receipt digest and project ownership checks. No wider permission or role grant.

approval.description: Research confirmation now requires private result storage before dispatch and persists the body before terminal success. Existing durable claims, approval scope and non-replay failure behavior remain. No automatic provider retry.

credentials.description: Existing boundary preserved, no provider calls or authorization change.

egress.description: Existing selected official API destination, secret rejection, redirect denial and tenant admission preserved. Price and reasoning controls are checked on serialized provider bytes. No new endpoint or credential.

cost.description: Existing model and output limit preserved. Forward the supported direct-output control and enforce catalogue price ceilings on the serialized request. Reserve conservatively and retain uncertain holds. No second formatting call or new provider.

billing.description: Settle validated provider usage.cost when supplied at integer micro-USD precision and bind it to the SDK completion and existing atomic receipt. Historical settled discrepancies are retained without manual financial SQL.

tests.scope: Focused adapter, input, calculator, owner/AAL2 founder gate and standard math parser tests. Conflicting stream/completion text regression reproduced before correction.

architecture.reason: Existing single-answer prompt and renderer plus existing confirmation and private storage handoff. No new scheduler, provider, model-formatting call or database schema.
